title: Dax to red, red to dax
hook: You always get 'dax → red' right. Does it work the other way round?

knows: reading short labels and comparing simple counts
doesNotKnow: that recall works in the direction you practise, so testing word-to-meaning does not check meaning-to-word

misconception: If you can give a word's meaning, you can also produce the word from its meaning.
objective: Distinguish two directions of an arbitrary word-pair mapping.
